iustitia.cfg.option.alertBatching.desc: Collapse rapid same-player flags into one line after a quiet window.
iustitia.cfg.option.alertBatching.name: Smart alert batching
iustitia.cfg.option.alertLevel.desc: 0 = quiet (red-severity only) · 1 = normal (orange + red) · 2 = verbose (all). Display-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.alertLevel.name: Alert level
iustitia.cfg.option.alertThrottle.desc: Min ticks between repeats of the same alert.
iustitia.cfg.option.alertThrottle.name: Alert throttle (ticks)
iustitia.cfg.option.audioCues.desc: Play a note-block cue per flushed alert batch (yellow vs red).
iustitia.cfg.option.audioCues.name: Audio cues
iustitia.cfg.option.audioVolume.name: Audio volume
iustitia.cfg.option.batchWindow.desc: Quiet ticks before a batch flushes (100 = 5s).
iustitia.cfg.option.batchWindow.name: Batch window (ticks)
iustitia.cfg.option.blinkFreezeTicks.des: Sustained airborne full-freeze ticks before a Fly(Blink) episode flag. A PURE midair freeze is 1v1-unobservable from a player-specific lag stall (that's what the server-lag burst exemption is for), so the default (30 = 1.5s) is deliberately conservative. Higher = fewer lag FPs, lower = faster blink detection.
iustitia.cfg.option.burstSparks.desc: Spawn a brief tier-colored (red/yellow) particle burst at a player's eye when a fresh tier-relevant alert fires — a visual flag cue mid-fight. Client-only (no packet). Render-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.burstSparks.name: Burst sparks
iustitia.cfg.option.chatAlerts.desc: Master switch for chat alert lines. Off = silence all alerts (detection + nametag tier keep running). Same as bare /ius alerts.
iustitia.cfg.option.chatAlerts.name: Chat alerts
iustitia.cfg.option.chathistCapture.desc: Capture messages from tracked OTHER players (not you, not system messages) for /ius chathist <user> / phrase / target. Per-server: persists across reconnects when 'Persist across sessions' is on, else in-memory only. Additive.
iustitia.cfg.option.chathistCapture.name: Chat history capture
iustitia.cfg.option.chathistUnknown.desc: Permissive / cross-server mode (OFF by default). Decorated chat (rank/star servers like Hypixel, ArchMC, Minemen) normally anchors the sender to the tab list — a sender not in the tab list is dropped. With this ON, those senders are still captured (best-effort: the last word before the separator), so Bungee/Velocity cross-sub-server chat is recorded. Less accurate on suffix-decorated formats (Minemen can mis-attribute), hence the OFF default.
iustitia.cfg.option.chathistUnknown.name: Chat history: capture unknown senders
iustitia.cfg.option.chunkCaptureRadius.d: Radius (in chunks) around you that /ius clip captures for the full world. 8 → 17×17 = 289 chunks. Larger = more of the map but a bigger clip file + a heavier bake. Modern-only.
Max chunks from the camera that /ius playclip renders of the captured chunk world per frame. Bounds per-frame cost (and thus FPS). Modern-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.clipEntities.desc: Capture + render non-player entities (mobs, animals, boats, minecarts) within 64 blocks while a replay/clip window is live, so playback shows the whole scene instead of players only. Modern-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.clipEntities.name: Clip captures entities
iustitia.cfg.option.clipFullWorld.desc: On /ius clip, snapshot every loaded chunk around you (full 16×16 columns, ALL Y sections — includes underground) and render the clip's world as SOLID textured blocks (the real map) with the live world hidden — free-spectate anywhere incl. underground. Modern-only — Legacy never downloads the world.
iustitia.cfg.option.clipFullWorld.name: Clip captures full world
iustitia.cfg.option.clipTerrain.desc: On /ius clip, also snapshot the loaded terrain around the action and render it (relocated to you) on playclip. Modern-only — Legacy clips are ghosts-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.clipTerrain.name: Clip captures terrain
iustitia.cfg.option.compactMode.name: Compact mode
iustitia.cfg.option.confidenceHud.desc: Draw a compact panel near the crosshair: the looked-at player's tier glyph + score + why-this-tier + FP hint. Display-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.confidenceHud.name: Crosshair confidence HUD
iustitia.cfg.option.decayPerTick.name: Decay / tick
iustitia.cfg.option.enabled.name: Enabled
iustitia.cfg.option.entityCaptureCap.des: Max non-player entities captured per tick. Bounds the per-tick cost and the clip's size. Modern-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.evidenceWindow.name: Evidence window (ticks)
iustitia.cfg.option.ghostEquipment.desc: Render each ghost's held items + armor (main hand, off hand, head, chest, legs, feet) during /ius playclip & /ius replay — what the player actually held/wore at the recorded tick. Lossy (no enchant glint). Natively on. Modern-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.ghostEquipment.name: Ghost equipment on clips
iustitia.cfg.option.greenTick.desc: Show the green [+] on low-flag players. Off = only mark yellow/red (less visual noise). Mute a check/player via /ius alerts.
iustitia.cfg.option.greenTick.name: Show green tick on clean players
iustitia.cfg.option.healthIndicator.desc: Show a numeric health line (e.g. 14/20) above each ghost's nametag during /ius playclip, plus a transient -dmg popup when a recorded player is hit. Natively off. Modern-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.healthIndicator.name: Health indicator on clips
iustitia.cfg.option.hoverTooltip.desc: After the crosshair rests on one player for ~1.5s, show an expanded top-center banner (tier + score + why-this-tier + FP hint + most-flagged checks). Suppresses the compact crosshair panel while up. Display-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.hoverTooltip.name: Hover tooltip
iustitia.cfg.option.joinGrace.desc: Ticks after a player joins before alerts (30s = 600).
iustitia.cfg.option.joinGrace.name: Join grace (ticks)
iustitia.cfg.option.lagHudIcon.desc: Draw a top-left ⚠ lag marker while a server-lag burst is recent. Display-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.lagHudIcon.name: Server-lag HUD indicator
iustitia.cfg.option.legitScaffoldStrictG: Extra motion/cadence gates for the LegitScaffold path (off = baseline Rain path). Flip on only to A/B-test a stationary-builder FP.
iustitia.cfg.option.nametagBurstPulse.de: Color-pulse the tier prefix for ~3s after a fresh yellow/red flag.
iustitia.cfg.option.nametagPrefixes.desc: Show a cheat-tier prefix (green [+] / yellow [!] / red [X]) above other players' names.
iustitia.cfg.option.nametagPrefixes.name: Nametag prefixes
iustitia.cfg.option.newSegmentDistance.d: Distance (blocks) you must move in one tick — or a world/dimension change — to start a NEW capture segment. Each segment keeps its own world snapshot + block edits, so a clip that spans a teleport replays both places. Lower = more, smaller segments. Modern-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.persistence.desc: Save notes, tier/flag history, snapshots & exports to %%APPDATA%%/.iustitia. Off = session-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.persistence.name: Persist across sessions
iustitia.cfg.option.playclipMode.desc: LEGACY = the v1.1.0 playclip: ghosts render over the LIVE world at their recorded coords, the player walks and acts normally, no world is downloaded. MODERN = the current feature set: solid captured chunk world (free-spectate anywhere, incl. underground), relocated scene, auto-freecam, and spectator-like input/packet suppression while the clip plays. Default MODERN (since v1.2.0 — the C2 FPS fix made Modern match the 120 cap); existing configs keep their saved choice.
iustitia.cfg.option.playclipMode.name: Playclip mode
iustitia.cfg.option.relocateScene.desc: On /ius playclip, translate the whole ghost scene (and chunk world) so the focus player starts at YOUR position instead of floating at the recorded coords. Modern-only — Legacy always plays a clip at the recorded coordinates.
iustitia.cfg.option.relocateScene.name: Relocate scene to me
iustitia.cfg.option.replayCapture.desc: Keep a rolling 60s buffer of every tracked player's position + every alert, so /ius replay and /ius clip can rewind/export the last N seconds. Off = skip the per-tick capture (disables replay + clip; detection keeps running).
iustitia.cfg.option.replayCapture.name: Replay capture buffer
iustitia.cfg.option.replayHideLive.desc: While a replay (/ius replay or /ius playclip) is active, hide every live OTHER player so only the buffered ghost copies render — a rewind-the-world feel. Off = overlay ghosts on the live scene. Render-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.replayHideLive.name: Replay hides live players
iustitia.cfg.option.replayKeybindSeconds: Seconds of buffered scene replayed when the replay-toggle keybind (numpad * by default) is pressed. 1..60 (capped to the 60s replay buffer).
iustitia.cfg.option.replayPlayerModels.d: Render replay/clip ghosts as the real Minecraft player model wearing each player's REAL skin (fetched from the tab list; Steve/Alex fallback) instead of the tier-colored humanoid box outline. On by default. The block scale + pose transforms are runtime-verified only — if a ghost renders at the wrong size or not at all, the box outline shows as fallback.
iustitia.cfg.option.rollingWorldBudget.d: Total non-empty chunk sections the rolling per-segment world capture holds across ALL segments before the oldest (never the current one) is evicted. A section is up to 4096 bytes, so 24000 is roughly 20–95 MB depending on how full the segments are. Lower it on a memory-tight client; raise it if a long /ius record keeps losing its earliest world. Modern-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.sensitivitySubstrate: Converges each player's mouse sensitivity to drive the KillAura + RotationTracking GCD (constant-rotation / too-clean pitch-step) sub-flags. OFF by default — the convergence is the dense-crowd FPS hog (profiled ~32%% of render time on high-turnover servers); with it off both GCD sub-flags self-disable (fail-open) and every other heuristic keeps running. Flip on to re-enable them, accepting the FPS cost.
iustitia.cfg.option.setbackVL.desc: Alert only when VL exceeds this.
iustitia.cfg.option.setbackVL.name: Setback VL
iustitia.cfg.option.softenOnLag.desc: Prefix [lag] and (under quiet) drop non-red alerts during a lag burst.
iustitia.cfg.option.softenOnLag.name: Soften alerts on server lag
iustitia.cfg.option.tabListBadge.desc: Prepend the tier glyph (+ score when nametag-badge is on) to each OTHER player's row in the Tab list. Follows the nametag settings; never touches your own row. Display-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.tabListBadge.name: Tab-list badge
iustitia.cfg.option.targetHighlight.desc: Draw a tier-colored wireframe box around the other player your crosshair is on. Depth-tested (no wallhack). Suspects always boxed; clean players only when nametag-green is on. Render-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.targetHighlight.name: On-world target highlight
iustitia.cfg.option.threshold.name: Threshold
iustitia.cfg.option.totemPopCounter.desc: Show a totem-pop count badge on each ghost's nametag during /ius playclip (Totem of Undying pops within the clip). Natively off. Modern-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.totemPopCounter.name: Totem pop counter on clips
iustitia.cfg.option.transcriptPanel.desc: Auto-show the transcript panel for your crosshair target.
iustitia.cfg.option.transcriptPanel.name: Transcript side panel
iustitia.cfg.option.verbose.name: Verbose
iustitia.cfg.option.watchFollowCam.desc: Press the watch keybind on a crosshair-targeted player to start a sustained slow auto-orbit camera around them; press again to stop. Auto-reverts to your view when you stop / they leave / the world changes. Render-only.
iustitia.cfg.option.watchFollowCam.name: Watch follow-cam
iustitia.cfg.title: Iustitia

iustitia.cmd.sub.alerts: toggle all chat alerts: /ius alerts  (or mute one: /ius alerts <name|check> [on|off])
iustitia.cmd.sub.chathist: chat history for tracked players: /ius chathist <username> [page], /ius chathist phrase <phrase> [page], /ius chathist target <username> <phrase> [page], /ius chathist panel user|phrase|target ...
iustitia.cmd.sub.clear: reset one player's flags (tier→green) or everyone's: /ius clear <name|all>
iustitia.cmd.sub.clip: export the last N seconds to a .iusclip file: /ius clip <seconds> [name]  (name = the clip's filename; also sets the focus player if name matches someone online; omit for scene_<tick>)
iustitia.cmd.sub.clips: open the clip manager screen: list saved .iusclip files, play or delete each
iustitia.cmd.sub.createpreset: save the current config as a custom preset: /ius createpreset <name>
iustitia.cmd.sub.debugfps: render-thread sampling profiler: /ius debugfps  (start), /ius debugfps stop  (write a text report to %%APPDATA%%/.iustitia/debugfps/)
iustitia.cmd.sub.deleteclip: delete a saved clip by name: /ius deleteclip <name>  (alias /ius delclip <name>)
iustitia.cmd.sub.deletepreset: delete a custom preset: /ius deletepreset <name>  (built-ins can't be deleted)
iustitia.cmd.sub.evidence: one chat line of a player's last few seconds of flags: /ius evidence <name>
iustitia.cmd.sub.exempt: exempt a player from all checks: /ius exempt [name [on|off]]  (bare = list exempted)
iustitia.cmd.sub.keybinds: open the keybind hub screen (lists binds, highlights conflicts)
iustitia.cmd.sub.note: moderator tag a player: /ius note <name> <closet|blatant|needsReview|legit> <text...>  (or /ius note <name> to view)
iustitia.cmd.sub.playclip: play back a saved .iusclip in-world at FULL speed by default: /ius playclip <name> [1|0.5|0.25]  (no name = list saved clips)
iustitia.cmd.sub.preset: apply a named config preset: /ius preset <name>  (bare = list; built-ins: %s; custom presets via /ius createpreset)
iustitia.cmd.sub.record: record the live scene for later export: /ius record  (start), /ius record stop [name]  (save as <name>.iusclip, capped at 10 min/segment)
iustitia.cmd.sub.replay: instant replay: /ius replay [<player>|<seconds>] [<seconds>] [1|0.5|0.25]  — rewinds the world and plays back ghost positions+look at FULL speed by default (add 0.5 or 0.25 for slow-mo). Examples: /ius replay 60 (60s, no focus), /ius replay thoria 60 0.5 (focus thoria, 60s, slow-mo). Controls while running: /ius replay pause|resume|seek <s>|step +|-|speed <1|0.5|0.25>|cam <free|follow|pov>|off  (numpad 5 = pause, +/- = seek 5s, numpad 0 = exit). Also /ius replay save <name> to save the replay you're watching as a clip.
iustitia.cmd.sub.report: copy a player's report card to clipboard: /ius report <name> [markdown|json|text]  (text = the chat-friendly transcript form)
iustitia.cmd.sub.session: session summary: tracked players, tier counts, who peaked highest  (or /ius session screen for the timeline screen)
iustitia.cmd.sub.snapshot: evidence snapshot of your crosshair target: /ius snapshot [name]
iustitia.cmd.sub.spectate: watch follow-cam on a player: /ius spectate [name]  (no name = crosshair target; /ius spectate off to stop; same as the watch keybind)
iustitia.cmd.sub.status: health panel: master, tracked players, protocol, alerts
iustitia.cmd.sub.transcript: print a player's session timeline to chat (text form of /ius report): /ius transcript <name>  (or /ius transcript panel [name] to toggle the side panel)
iustitia.cmd.transcriptExportFail: %s §ctranscript export failed (disk error) — chat still has the full text.
iustitia.cmd.transcriptPanelLook: %s §7look at a player to open their transcript panel (or use §f/ius transcript panel <name>§7).
iustitia.cmd.transcriptPrinted: %s §7transcript for %s§7 printed §8(paste into a report; same as §f/ius report %s text§7)
iustitia.cmd.verboseBacklog: §7%s line(s) still queued — still writing to §flogs/latest.log§7 in the background.
iustitia.cmd.verboseDropped: §7note: §f%s§7 verbose line(s) were dropped this session (appender could not keep up), so the transcript is §fpartial§7. Detection data is unaffected — §f/ius hist§7 keeps the exact per-flag record.
iustitia.info.check.aimWrap: Aim rotated faster than a legit flick (>threshold°/tick).
iustitia.info.check.autoBlock: Swung while a shield was raised (auto-block / block-hit).
iustitia.info.check.backtrack: Hit a victim from a stale (backtracked) position.
iustitia.info.check.backwardSprint: Sprinted backward or strafe-only (impossible in vanilla; needs forward input).
iustitia.info.check.clickStatistics: Click cadence too uniform / too fast (autoclicker).
iustitia.info.check.criticals: Spoofed a grounded crit hop to score a crit while on the ground.
iustitia.info.check.elytraSpeed: Elytra glide exceeded the vanilla speed cap.
iustitia.info.check.flyEnvelope: Vertical motion broke vanilla physics (fly / hover / ascend).
iustitia.info.check.hitFlick: Redirected aim off the hitbox at the attack tick (HitFlick).
iustitia.info.check.hitsWithoutSwing: Dealt damage with no swing animation in the window (no-swing attack).
iustitia.info.check.jumpOnHurt: Jumped instantly on taking damage (anti-KB hop).
iustitia.info.check.keepSprint: Kept sprinting through an attack instead of the legit slowdown.
iustitia.info.check.killAura: Silent-aim / aim-snap suite: attacked without facing the victim.
iustitia.info.check.longJump: Covered too much horizontal distance in one air tick.
iustitia.info.check.maceSmash: Faked a fall-height Y warp around a mace smash-attack (MaceKill).
iustitia.info.check.multiTarget: Struck ≥2 distinct victims in one tick (multi-aura).
iustitia.info.check.noFallDamage: Spoofed on-ground to avoid fall damage.
iustitia.info.check.noKnockback: Took a hit without the expected knockback (anti-KB).
iustitia.info.check.noSlow: Moved at full speed while using an item that should slow you.
iustitia.info.check.packetGap: Packet timing gap inconsistent with vanilla ticking (timer/blinker).
iustitia.info.check.phaseClip: Moved through a solid block (phase / no-clip).
iustitia.info.check.reach: Hit a victim beyond vanilla melee reach (lag-compensated).
iustitia.info.check.rotationSnapBack: Aim snapped back after an attack (aim-snap).
iustitia.info.check.rotationTracking: Aim rotated too uniformly while tracking a target.
iustitia.info.check.scaffoldRotation: Scaffold placement rotation inconsistent with legit bridging.
iustitia.info.check.speedEnvelope: Moved horizontally faster than the vanilla speed envelope.
iustitia.info.check.spider: Climbed a wall without a ladder/vine (spider / constant-climb).
iustitia.info.check.sprintHack: Sprinted in water / while sneaking / while blind (all vanilla-blocked).
iustitia.info.check.stepHeight: Stepped up a block higher than the vanilla step height.
iustitia.info.check.teleport: Position jumped in a way that isn't a vanilla teleport/pearl.
iustitia.info.check.throughWalls: Hit through walls: too many recent hits had no line-of-sight to the victim's body.
iustitia.info.check.triggerbot: Auto-attacked the instant the crosshair reached a hitbox (sub-reaction).
iustitia.info.check.wTap: Reset sprint KB pattern mismatch (W-Tap / SuperKB cheat).
iustitia.info.check.wallSprint: Held sprint metadata while pressed against a wall (OmniSprint).
iustitia.info.feature.alerts: /ius alerts toggles all chat alerts on/off. /ius alerts <name|check> [on|off] mutes one player or check's chat (detection + tiering keep running).
iustitia.info.feature.clip: /ius clip <seconds> [name] exports the last N seconds of your own and every tracked player's positions + every alert to a portable .iusclip file under %%APPDATA%%/.iustitia/clips — an evidence clip you can play back later with /ius playclip, not just a screenshot. [name] tags the focus player into the clip. Always writes (explicit export, independent of the persist-across-sessions toggle).
iustitia.info.feature.compact: Compact mode shrinks alert lines and the history/session/transcript screens to one-line summaries for users who hate clutter. Toggle it with the `compact` keybind or the config screen.
iustitia.info.feature.evidence: /ius evidence <name> collapses the last few seconds of a player's flags (window set by the Evidence window config) into ONE chat line you can paste straight into a report.
iustitia.info.feature.hist: /ius hist opens the searchable player list; /ius hist <name> opens that player's profile card (tier, confidence, max-VL-per-check bar) + filtered flag timeline with evidence rows. Click an alert to jump there.
iustitia.info.feature.keybinds: The keybind hub screen lists every Iustitia bind with its current key and a one-line description, and highlights any that conflict with another bind in red. Open it from the `keybinds` keybind.
iustitia.info.feature.note: /ius note <name> <category> <text...> tags a player as closet / blatant / needsReview / legit. The note follows them for the session and, with persistence on, across restarts. /ius note <name> (no category) re-reads it.
iustitia.info.feature.playclip: /ius playclip [name] plays a saved .iusclip back in-world as ghost positions at full speed by default, exactly like /ius replay but from a file. Your own recorded body is in the clip and your live one is hidden while it plays. No name = list your saved clips. /ius playclip off stops a playing clip early.
iustitia.info.feature.replay: /ius replay <player> <seconds> [0.5|0.25] reconstructs an instant replay from the rolling 60s capture buffer: translucent ghost copies of you and every tracked player at their buffered positions, played back at full speed by default, with the live world and your own live body hidden (rewind feel). The named player is the highlighted focus ghost. Auto-stops at the end; /ius replay off stops early. Needs the Replay capture buffer on in config.
iustitia.info.feature.report: /ius report <name> [markdown|json|text] builds a full report card from the same data as the history screen and copies it to your clipboard — paste it into a Discord report. `text` is the chat-friendly transcript form (session stats + moderator note + timeline) — the same builder `/ius transcript <name>` prints to chat.
iustitia.info.feature.session: /ius session prints a session summary: total players tracked, how many hit each tier, who peaked highest (confidence score), and total alerts.
iustitia.info.feature.snapshot: The snapshot keybind posts a one-line evidence summary to chat ([Iustitia] PlayerX: Reach 4.2 | Tier: RED [87]), copies it to your clipboard, and (with persistence on) saves a .json snapshot. The screenshot + target highlight is a Phase B render feature.
iustitia.info.feature.spectate: /ius spectate [name] starts the watch follow-cam on the named player (or your crosshair target when no name is given) — same as the watch keybind (default F9) but works by name without needing them under your crosshair. /ius spectate off (or bare /ius spectate while already watching) stops it. Forces F1, third-party view of the target with all entities (including yourself) visible; mouse to orbit, move or get hit to stop.
iustitia.info.feature.transcript: /ius transcript <name> prints a Discord-copyable timeline of a player's session — swings, inferred hits, reach samples, velocity received, and which checks fired — straight to chat. It's the chat-print form of `/ius report <name> text` (same builder, different output: transcript → chat + export file, report → clipboard). Add `panel` to toggle the live side panel for your crosshair target (also a keybind + a config toggle).
iustitia.info.feature.watch: The watch keybind (default F9) toggles the follow-cam on your crosshair target — same as /ius spectate. It forces F1 (HUD hidden) and a third-party view of the target with all entities — including yourself — visible; move the mouse to orbit (the target stays centered), walk or get hit to stop, press the bind again to exit. Auto-reverts if the target leaves render range.
iustitia.info.feature.wizard: The first-launch setup wizard asks how you use Iustitia (General / Moderation / Ranked Player) and pre-sets alert level, nametag, audio, batching, compact mode and persistence to sensible defaults you can tweak later in /ius config. Only appears once.
iustitia.info.fpHint.aimWrap: a fast legit flick can exceed the per-tick yaw threshold.
iustitia.info.fpHint.autoBlock: block-hit + sprint-jitter can overlap swing/use on legit players.
iustitia.info.fpHint.backtrack: high-latency legit players hit from a slightly stale position.
iustitia.info.fpHint.backwardSprint: some minigame servers permit backward sprint via plugins.
iustitia.info.fpHint.clickStatistics: drag-click mice + jitter-bursts can look like an autoclicker.
iustitia.info.fpHint.criticals: slime/fence-edge bob while attacking can look like a grounded crit hop.
iustitia.info.fpHint.elytraSpeed: firework boosts + trident riptide glide exceed the baseline cap legitly.
iustitia.info.fpHint.flyEnvelope: ice/boat/slime bounce, levitation, slow-fall, wind-charges look like vertical breaks.
iustitia.info.fpHint.hitFlick: fast aim re-centring after a hit can flick off the hitbox.
iustitia.info.fpHint.hitsWithoutSwing: an out-of-view / untracked attacker or packet ordering can drop the swing — weak signal, corroborator-only.
iustitia.info.fpHint.jumpOnHurt: jumping on damage is common in parkour/bridge PvP.
iustitia.info.fpHint.keepSprint: sprint-reset (W-tap) legit PvP deliberately resets the slowdown.
iustitia.info.fpHint.killAura: fast legit flicks + high CPS can trip the silent-aim suite standalone.
iustitia.info.fpHint.longJump: Jump Boost + sprint-jump + momentum covers extra distance; ice/packed-ice more.
iustitia.info.fpHint.maceSmash: slime-bounce / wind-charge launches / lag-rubberband can produce a Y spike near an attack.
iustitia.info.fpHint.multiTarget: multi-mob farms / cleave can hit several targets in one tick legitly.
iustitia.info.fpHint.noFallDamage: arena-drop / water / ladder / chunk-load glitches all avoid fall damage legitly.
iustitia.info.fpHint.noKnockback: Velocity/sprint-reset knockback reduction is client-side noisy; intermittent is normal.
iustitia.info.fpHint.noSlow: some server versions don't apply use-slowdown consistently.
iustitia.info.fpHint.packetGap: lag bursts / blink-style server hiccups gap the packet stream.
iustitia.info.fpHint.phaseClip: lag-rubberband / chunk-load can momentarily place a player inside a block.
iustitia.info.fpHint.pitchBound: rare server mods permit extended pitch; usually a blatant client though.
iustitia.info.fpHint.reach: lag can inflate distance; check the server-lag indicator before calling reach.
iustitia.info.fpHint.rotationSnapBack: fast re-centring after a hit snaps aim back.
iustitia.info.fpHint.rotationTracking: intense PvP tracking can look uniform; tier-neutral (won't yellow on its own).
iustitia.info.fpHint.scaffoldRotation: legit bridging on some servers has looser rotation constraints.
iustitia.info.fpHint.speedEnvelope: Speed pots, dash, ice, riptide, dolphin, vehicle all raise the speed cap.
iustitia.info.fpHint.spider: bubble columns / levitation near a wall / lag-rubberband can momentarily ascend against a wall.
iustitia.info.fpHint.sprintHack: metadata-lag edges can briefly co-set sprint with sneak/water; the sustain gate absorbs these.
iustitia.info.fpHint.stepHeight: Jump Boost raises the vanilla step ceiling — a JB II step is normal.
iustitia.info.fpHint.teleport: pearls, chorus fruit, end-teleport, server teleports, lag-rubberband all jump position.
iustitia.info.fpHint.throughWalls: a legit player repeatedly peeking the same corner can occlude most of their hits; check the rate isn't one snap.
iustitia.info.fpHint.triggerbot: low-latency + high-CPS players can hit at the sub-reaction threshold.
iustitia.info.fpHint.wTap: legit sprint-reset PvP mimics the W-tap pattern.
iustitia.info.fpHint.wallSprint: a sprint-jump at a wall can briefly hold sprint metadata against it before vanilla cancels.
iustitia.info.fpHint.waterWalk: frost walker / boat dismount / lag-rubberband can momentarily walk on water.
